description: This file defines structures, classes, and functions related to TLS pinning and certificate validation in a networking context, specifically for managing TLS fingerprints, TLS session handling, and server trust challenge validation in a Swift environment.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket sessions with customized TLS handling, including validation and server trust challenge handling.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads the TLS fingerprint associated with a given stable ID from the keychain or legacy storage.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves the TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID into secure storage.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Clears the stored fingerprint for a specified stable ID.

methods.name: clearAllFingerprints
methods.description: Removes all stored TLS fingerprints from secure storage.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task with a specified URL, setting a maximum message size.

methods.name: urlSession(didReceive:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles server trust challenges, validates certificates, checks fingerprints, and manages TLS authorization based on configuration.
